```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE,
                      fig.align = "center", out.width = "100%")
library(readr)
library(knitr)

project_root <- if (dir.exists(file.path("data", "Cheyenne_ppt_temp_hourly"))) {
  getwd()
} else {
  normalizePath("..", winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE)
}
analysis_dir <- file.path(project_root, "data", "Cheyenne_ppt_temp_hourly", "analysis")
season_summary <- read_csv(file.path(analysis_dir, "season_summary.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
data_quality <- read_csv(file.path(analysis_dir, "data_quality.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
monthly_summary <- read_csv(file.path(analysis_dir, "monthly_summary.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
weekly_weather_summary <- read_csv(file.path(analysis_dir, "weekly_weather_summary.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
weekly_rainfall <- read_csv(file.path(analysis_dir, "weekly_rainfall.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
weekly_rainfall_totals <- weekly_rainfall |>
  dplyr::group_by(site, season) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    weeks_reported = dplyr::n(),
    total_rainfall_mm = sum(rain_mm, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_weekly_rainfall_mm = mean(rain_mm, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
rainfall_overlap_monthly <- read_csv(file.path(analysis_dir, "mahela_haenertsburg_monthly_overlap.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
rainfall_overlap_summary <- read_csv(file.path(analysis_dir, "mahela_haenertsburg_overlap_summary.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
daily_weather_overlap <- read_csv(file.path(analysis_dir, "mahela_haenertsburg_daily_weather_overlap.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
daily_weather_overlap_summary <- read_csv(file.path(analysis_dir, "mahela_haenertsburg_daily_weather_summary.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
agdd_summary <- read_csv(file.path(analysis_dir, "agdd_summary.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
station_season_availability <- read_csv(file.path(analysis_dir, "station_season_availability.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
```

# Overview

This report compares hourly temperature and humidity records from Haka and Mahela, alongside daily temperature, humidity, and rainfall from the Haenertsburg station and rainfall from the Haka event logs and filtered Mahela farm table. Haenertsburg is approximately 15 km from the Limpopo orchard, so it represents nearby regional conditions rather than measurements at the orchard. Logger intervals and source aggregation differ, so interpret comparisons in the context of each source's coverage.

This script imports data tables and summaries created by analyze_weather.R which imports, checks, and cleans and summarizes the weather data.


# Data availability by station and season

The table summarizes which measurements are available at each station in each season, their resolution, observation count, and date coverage. The file columns identify the source workbook or logger export for each measurement. Mahela rainfall has monthly totals in earlier periods and dated near-daily estimates in later periods; monthly-only values are not converted to weekly observations.

```{r station-season-availability}
kable(station_season_availability, caption = "Weather data availability by station and season")
```

# Seasonal summary

```{r seasonal-summary}

```

# Data quality

The importer excludes temperature values outside −10°C to 50°C and records where both temperature and relative humidity equal 0, which are treated as sensor failures. This removes implausible logger codes, including repeated −40°C and 80°C values in Mahela 2024–25. The audit below reports temperature-range exclusions, zero/zero sensor exclusions, and the combined count for each source.

```{r data-quality}
kable(data_quality, caption = "Temperature records checked against the plausibility range")
```

## Accumulated growing degree days (AGDD)

The AGDD season starts on 1 September, a practical start date consistent with South African kiwifruit budbreak reported in early to mid-September; actual timing varies by cultivar and orchard ([TopFruit cultivar information](https://www.topfruit.co.za/fruit/ya-50/)). Daily minimum and maximum temperatures are calculated from available logger readings at each site. Daily GDD is `max(0, ((Tmax + Tmin) / 2) - 4°C)`, with no upper temperature cap, and AGDD is the cumulative sum of observed daily GDD. Days without logger observations are omitted from the accumulation and appear as gaps in the curves.

```{r agdd-summary}
kable(agdd_summary, digits = 1, caption = "AGDD and daily weather coverage by site and growing season")
```


# Mahela–Haenertsburg comparison

## Daily temperature and humidity overlap

Mahela's cleaned hourly logger records are averaged by calendar date and matched to Haenertsburg's daily mean temperature and relative humidity. Dates are retained when both variables have at least 75% of the modal daily record count for that Mahela season. This accommodates the hourly and three-hourly logger schedules (typically at least 18 of 24 or 6 of 8 readings) while excluding very incomplete days. The time-series plot is faceted by Mahela season, with each x-axis limited to that season's paired measurement period so long spans without measurements do not obscure the station comparison. Bias is calculated as Haenertsburg minus Mahela. Since the station is approximately 15 km from the orchard, differences also reflect local spatial variation.

```{r daily-weather-overlap-summary}
kable(daily_weather_overlap_summary, digits = 2,
      caption = "Paired daily temperature and relative humidity by calendar year and overall")
```

```{r daily-weather-overlap-timeseries, out.height="auto"}
knitr::include_graphics(file.path(analysis_dir, "mahela_haenertsburg_daily_weather_timeseries.png"))
```

```{r daily-weather-overlap-scatter, out.height="auto"}

```

## Rainfall

The Mahela source provides rainfall records with month but no usable daily date, so its records are summed by calendar month. Haenertsburg daily rainfall is also summed by calendar month; only months with complete daily station coverage are included. The comparison is matched by calendar month, and the difference is calculated as Haenertsburg minus Mahela. Because the station is about 15 km from the orchard, the comparison describes regional agreement rather than duplicate measurements at the same location.

```{r rainfall-overlap-summary}
kable(rainfall_overlap_summary, digits = 2,
      caption = "Paired monthly rainfall comparison by calendar year and overall")
```

```{r rainfall-overlap-monthly-plot, out.height="auto"}

```


# Rainfall

Haka rainfall is recorded by event; Mahela has monthly farm totals in earlier periods and dated near-daily estimates during parts of later seasons; Haenertsburg provides daily rainfall from a station approximately 15 km from the Mahela orchard in Limpopo. In both rainfall plots, bars show period totals on the left axis and lines show cumulative totals for each site and season on the right axis; cumulative totals reset at the start of each season. Monthly panels use independent zero-based scales by site. Weekly totals include Haka events, Mahela's dated estimates, and Haenertsburg daily records. Mahela monthly-only totals remain in the monthly plot and are not apportioned to weeks.

# Method and coverage

Five logger seasons were imported from CSV and Excel files, with Excel serial dates and the 2023–24 Mahela decimal-comma format handled during import. Haenertsburg daily climate data cover 1 January 2023 through 31 December 2024 and are assigned to October–September seasons for seasonal grouping. The daily comparison uses matched dates and season-specific logger coverage thresholds. Monthly summaries report means and observed ranges. Seasonal means are descriptive and do not adjust for differences in coverage or sampling intervals.

The Haka workbook named for 2025–26 spans September 2024 through May 2026. The date range in [season_summary.csv](../data/Cheyenne_ppt_temp_hourly/analysis/season_summary.csv) shows this coverage directly.

# Weekly summaries

Weeks begin on Sunday. Temperature and relative humidity are summarized by site, season, and week using the available logger readings. The table includes the observation count, weekly mean, minimum, and maximum for each variable. Haka rainfall is summarized by week from event records; Haenertsburg rainfall is summed from daily records; and Mahela rainfall uses only rows with a source date, which are near-daily estimates. Monthly-only Mahela totals remain excluded from weekly aggregation.

```{r weekly-weather}
kable(weekly_weather_summary, digits = 2, caption = "Weekly temperature and relative humidity summaries") |> kableExtra::kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"), fixed_thead = T)
```
